Definition: diminutive of G4094; a tablet (for writing on):--writing table.
BiblicalUsage: A pinakidion is a little writing tablet. Zacharias asked for one in Luke 1:63, and wrote, His name is John — the first words he spoke after months of silence, and the neighbours marvelled.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives a voice back to the man who trusts His word, even if it comes on a tablet first.
